calendar.instructions: Arrow keys move between days, Page Up and Page Down change the month, Home and End go to the start and the end of the week. Enter opens a day. Hold Shift with the arrow keys to select days, then press Enter to use them; Escape clears the selection.
calendar.list: Days that differ from the weekly pattern
calendar.listEmpty: Every day of {period} follows the weekly pattern.

lab.label: Calendar · Demo Nord site · Line 2
lab.noCalendar: No calendar yet — the site default (Monday to Friday, one shift) is used until you set one.
lab.readOnly: Read-only: you need the Planning settings permission to change calendars. An administrator can give it to you.
lab.errorReason: The server did not answer in time. Nothing is drawn, so an empty calendar is never shown by mistake.
lab.opened: {date} opened: the exception popover opens here (an extra shift, a short day, the line closed).
lab.rangeAsked_one: {from} selected: the screen now asks “Closure on this day?” and shows the lines whose capacity changes.
lab.rangeAsked_other: {from} to {to} selected ({count} days): the screen now asks “Closure from … to …?” and shows the lines whose capacity changes.
